entities.name: Livonian War & Swedish Takeover
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Ivan the Terrible's invasion of Livonia (1558), the collapse of the Livonian Confederation, and the partition of Estonian territory among Sweden, Denmark, Poland-Lithuania, and Russia. Northern Estonia chose Swedish protection.
